title: Cap loyalty discount for hotel booking price quotes
description: As a hotel guest, I want loyalty and promotional discounts to be capped during price quote calculation so that displayed booking totals are accurate and revenue rules are protected.

acceptanceCriteria.text: When a loyalty member applies a promotional discount, the total discount must not exceed 30 percent of the nightly base price.
The booking price quote should include the final total, applied discount amount, and a discount reason when a cap is applied.
Automated tests cover standard guests, loyalty guests below the cap, and loyalty guests whose discount is capped at 30 percent.

technicalConstraints: Keep discount calculation inside existing pricing or discount service boundaries.
Do not change booking persistence behavior for this story.
securityExpectations: Do not log guest personal data, loyalty identifiers, tokens, or full booking payloads.
performanceExpectations: Price quote calculation should remain in-memory and should not add a new external service call per quote.
testExpectations: Add focused tests for discount cap behavior.
Add at least one test proving uncapped discounts still work below the limit.
